scope: Exact ordered local SQLite inbox on pending-heavy fixed fixtures; no model/token/e2e claims

implementation.procedure: Read exact source/query diff and executed SQL, immutable semantics and ledger
implementation.acceptance: Equivalent join-key ORDER BY only; API/schema/evidence unchanged

reference_boundary.procedure: Independent list oracle, four-run layouts, limits/ACK/restart/nonconsecutive IDs

data_integrity.acceptance: Complete finite raw observations and no discarded failures

measurement_validity.procedure: Full public method/connect/JSON timing without VM callback; VM separate; matched paired alternating order
measurement_validity.acceptance: 20k single/interleaved VM>=10x and median>=2x; small/write <=2x or<1ms added; adverse layouts retained

reproducibility.acceptance: Exact outputs and frozen performance thresholds reproduce
